req.title: Redirect to arbitrary URL
req.statement: The system shall issue an HTTP 302 redirect to the URL given by the 'url' query parameter of /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should issue an HTTP 302 redirect to a URL provided by the 'url' query parameter. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct redirection, a negative test to handle missing URL parameters, and a boundary test to check URL encoding and handling of special characters.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_valid_url
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a valid URL as the 'url' query parameter.
expected: The 'Location' header matches the provided URL.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=https://example.com')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'https://example.com'

tests.name: test_redirect_to_missing_url
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to without the 'url' query parameter.
expected: The response status code is 400 indicating a client error.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to')
assert response.status_code == 400

tests.name: test_redirect_to_encoded_url
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a URL containing special characters that need encoding.
expected: The 'Location' header matches the encoded URL.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
encoded_url = 'https://example.com/path%20with%20spaces'
response = client.get(f'/redirect-to?url={encoded_url}')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'https://example.com/path%20with%20spaces'
